newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-FRANCE DROP LAMA, RECALL DJORKAEFF.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FRANCE DROP LAMA, RECALL DJORKAEFF.

text.p: France recalled Internazionale striker Youri Djorkaeff but dropped first-choice goalkeeper Bernard Lama on Monday for their friendly against Sweden at the Parc des Princes on Wednesday.
Manager Aime Jacquet, who was forced to leave Djorkaeff at the disposal of his Italian club in France's last outing against the Netherlands last month, named the striker in a squad of 19 players.
Jacquet had vowed to make changes in this last match before June's Tournoi de France involving Italy, Brazil and England. The tournament is seen as a dress-rehearsal for next year's World Cup finals.
He has also recalled centre forward Marc Keller who has been in excellent form with Karlsruhe in the Bundesliga.
Jacquet, who has struggled to find the right formula up front, kept faith in AC Milan's Christophe Dugarry, in-form PSG striker Patrice Loko and Bordeaux forward Ibrahim Ba.
Lama -- for Jacquet the "undisputed first choice as goalkeeper" -- surrendered his place to Monaco's Fabien Barthez.
The Paris St Germain keeper was not even named as a substitute, with uncapped Lionel Charbonnier of Auxerre the second choice.
Midfielder Claude Makelele was named in the squad for the first time since 1995 when he won his only cap against Norway.
Defenders - Laurent Blanc (Barcelona), Patrick Blondeau (Monaco), Vincent Candela (Roma), Marcel Desailly (AC Milan), Pierre Laigle (Sampdoria), Lilian Thuram (Parma)
Midfielders - Didier Deschamps (Juventus), Martin Djetou (Monaco), Franck Gava (Lyon), Claude Makelele (Nantes), Patrick Vieira (Arsenal), Zinedine Zidane (Juventus)
Forwards - Ibrahim Ba (Bordeaux), Youri Djorkaeff (Internazionale), Christophe Dugarry (AC Milan), Marc Keller (Karlsruhe), Patrice Loko (Paris St Germain).
